entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A Mirran goblin with an affinity for artifacts and an odd way of speaking, later compleated into a Phyrexian.

entities.name: Dwugget
entities.description: The head of the Krark Cult, who found and raised Slobad.

entities.name: Raksha
entities.description: The young leader of the Leonin who kept Slobad as a servant and later befriends Glissa.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elf captured by the levelers whom Slobad helps; her latent spark is Memnarch's goal.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: An intelligent golem Slobad repairs, who gives his life to spare his friends.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A necromancer who ruled Ish Sah and later becomes a guardian of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: The individual orchestrating the attacks, whom Glissa kills.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The ancient being at Mirrodin's core responsible for the attacks, obsessed with Glissa's spark.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The planeswalker who created Mirrodin and offers to make Slobad his apprentice.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane created by Karn, ruled by Memnarch.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: The Leonin capital where Glissa's wound is treated.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: The heart of the Mephidross, ruled by Geth.

entities.name: Krark Cult
entities.description: A group of goblin outcasts led by Dwugget.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: The cat-like people who capture Slobad and later heal Glissa.

entities.name: Levelers
entities.description: Horrible murderous machines found in a cavern in the Oxidda Mountains.

entities.name: Viridian Elves
entities.description: The elves who arrest Glissa and Slobad for the murder of Glissa's parents.

entities.name: Kaldra Guardian
entities.description: The Kaldra avatar that Memnarch takes control of and which is blasted away by green mana.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian who sends obsolete Phyrexians to Slobad for repurposing.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane whose oil compleats Slobad.

events.summary: Slobad is born under the Eye of Doom, a taboo meaning death, but his mother hides him in the air ducts.
events.quote: Slobad's mother did not follow tradition and instead hid the young goblin in the air ducts

events.summary: Dwugget finds the infant Slobad and raises him in the Krark Cult.
events.quote: the infant goblin was found by another goblin by the name of Dwugget.

events.summary: The Leonin capture Slobad and make him a servant of their leader Raksha.
events.quote: he was captured by the Leonin and turned into a servant

events.summary: Slobad flees after a failed invention and finds the levelers' cavern.
events.quote: Slobad decided it was best to flee before any punishment could be forthcoming

events.summary: Slobad helps the captured elf Glissa free herself and leads her to Taj-Nar to be healed.
events.quote: Slobad leads her back to Taj-Nar where the leonin could heal her wounds.

events.summary: Slobad repairs the golem Bosh, who joins Glissa and Slobad.
events.quote: introduced himself as Bosh

events.summary: The group defeats the necromancer Geth at Ish Sah.
events.quote: ruled by the necromancer Geth

events.summary: Glissa kills Pontifex, who was orchestrating the attacks.
events.quote: Glissa confronted the mysterious individual orchestrating the attacks

events.summary: The group learns Memnarch is responsible for the attacks.
events.quote: The ancient and mythical being known as Memnarch was responsible for the attacks.

events.summary: The Kaldra avatar betrays the group when Memnarch takes control of it.
events.quote: they were betrayed by the avatar when Memnarch gained control of it.

events.summary: Bosh stays behind and gives his life so his friends can escape.
events.quote: Bosh stayed behind while the pair escaped, giving his life to spare his friends.

events.summary: The Fifth Dawn is triggered and a new green sun is born.
events.quote: The Fifth Dawn was triggered, blasting the Kaldra Guardian away

events.summary: The Viridian Elves arrest Glissa and Slobad for the murder of Glissa's parents.
events.quote: were immediately arrested by the Viridian Elves for the murder of Glissa's parents

events.summary: Glissa falls into a trap at Ish-Sah, leaving Slobad alone.
events.quote: Glissa fell into a horrible trap

events.summary: Memnarch captures Slobad, tortures him, amputates his limbs and links him to a machine.
events.quote: Slobad was captured without much fight and Memnarch made plans to utilize the goblin's brilliance.

events.summary: Glissa knocks herself and Memnarch into the core and her spark transfers to Slobad.
events.quote: her spark was accidentally transferred to his battered form

events.summary: Slobad meets Karn, the creator of Mirrodin.
events.quote: he came face to face with the planeswalker who had created Mirrodin itself: Karn

events.summary: Slobad gives up the spark to resurrect the dead and send them home.
events.quote: the goblin gave up the spark to resurrect all the people killed on Mirrodin and send them home

events.summary: Slobad is thought killed by panicked goblins, then compleated by Phyrexia.
events.quote: Slobad reluctantly accepted as the Phyrexian oil reshaped his body.

events.summary: Slobad toils in the Salvage Complex managing waste disposal for Phyrexia.
events.quote: Urabrask sent obsolete Phyrexians to him for repurposing.

relations.note: Dwugget raised Slobad as if his own.
relations.quote: he raised Slobad as if he were his own
Glissa and Slobad struck out to learn who their mysterious enemy was
the planeswalker who had created Mirrodin itself

relations.note: Slobad fixes Bosh; Bosh gives his life for his friends.
relations.quote: giving his life to spare his friends
Slobad was captured without much fight
